understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spike tiles.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal moves shift the player left or right, then gravity automatically carries the player until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. The structured landing previews and corridor scan identify safe destinations and passage columns. Clicking a specified breakable tile removes it without moving the player or advancing the rising-platform timer; moves consume turns. Landing on spikes ends the attempt, and UNDO can revert the previous action.
